decisions.reason: As a multi-model product line closely tied to the firm's core formwork and factory-equipment business and visibly promoted on its own page, it has high strategic fit and enough sunk engineering and marketing investment to favor continued commitment.

This shuttering magnet block line is close to the established offer and benefits from the firm's modular technology base, so management is likely to interpret any weaker traction as temporary and continue supporting it.

Because it was given a dedicated webpage and fits the firm's announced path of broadening its technology portfolio, prior public commitment and product-development effort make withdrawal relatively unlikely.

Although its public visibility was lower than A or E, it still sits near the core product range and in an expanding firm and industry management would likely keep it for now rather than admit a failed launch.
